paper_title: CodeRAG-Bench Can Retrieval Augment Code Generation
caption: Performance with different chunking sizes.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the performance of different models, represented by distinct lines, across a range of token counts. The x-axis, labeled “Number of Tokens,” utilizes a linear scale with values ranging from approximately 200 to 800, marked with tick intervals of 200, and unitless. The y-axis, labeled “Performance,” ranges from approximately 10 to 30, with tick intervals of 10. The blue line, marked with solid circles, begins at a value around 25 and decreases to approximately 20 at the end of the x-axis. The orange line, marked with solid circles, starts at a value of approximately 28 and decreases to approximately 15 at the end of the x-axis. The green line, marked with solid circles, begins at a value of approximately 30 and decreases to approximately 28 at the end of the x-axis. The yellow line, marked with solid circles, begins at a value of approximately 28 and decreases to approximately 18 at the end of the x-axis.
